Source contracts: scripts/binary_native_audit.py

scripts/binary_native_audit.py

Python · Tier B

Inspect native loader dependencies and close approved Linux runtime libraries.

Usage

Called by the native builder for staged runtimes and compiled launchers.

Inputs

Image or launcher path, target architecture and system-library policy.

Side effects

Inspection invokes native analysis tools without running inspected files; Linux closure copies approved host libraries/notices and patches relative RPATHs.

Cleanup

Subprocess calls complete synchronously; the builder owns staged outputs.

@see scripts/native_binary_builder.py

@see packaging/binary/system-libraries.json

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
native_files 25 Not yet documented
close_linux_libraries 36 Carry the small non-base system closure; normalize every ELF search path. Only explicit runtime sonames are eligible for host acquisition. Record package identity and original hashes, carry distro notices, and require release review. No LD_LIBRARY_PATH changes can escape into user commands.
inspect_native 139 Report dependency resolution, architecture and loader-policy errors for a target. Inspect ELF, Mach-O or PE headers with host tools, retaining file hashes and the highest referenced GLIBC version. Policy violations are returned as findings; unavailable or failing inspection tools propagate their errors.
